name: Bergfreunde
description: German outdoor retailer selling clothing, footwear and equipment for mountain sports, climbing, trekking, biking, winter sports and camping. Its delivery page lists Germany with a free-shipping threshold and about 30 other countries.
description_es: Tienda alemana de artículos outdoor con ropa, calzado y equipamiento para montañismo, escalada, trekking, ciclismo, deportes de invierno y camping. Su página de entrega incluye Alemania con envío gratis desde un monto mínimo y unos 30 países más.

ships_to.notes: Delivery zone Germany at 3.95 EUR, free from 99 EUR order value. No regional or island limits stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Customer pickup is not described on the delivery page.

shopping_notes: Product pages in German. Invoice payment is offered. Free return period is advertised as 100 days.

sources.supports: delivery countries including Germany and shipping thresholds
